answer: Shared payout ceiling: all accounts funded from one wallet split a single 100 POA reward cap per epoch, and each new account locks 20 POA for 30 days. One fake locks 20 POA; 10 lock 200; 100 lock 2000, yet they still share one cap, while an honest user locks 20 POA once. Auditors read the public ledger, where a ripple of small transfers from one wallet exposes a cluster. A violet audit log lists flagged clusters, which lose their deposits, and 10% goes to the reporter from the pearl reserve. Limit: attackers can fund fakes from many wallets.
